name: CanvasKit / Skia
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Skia in WASM: Node-runnable 2D canvas with shaping, SkSL shaders and PDF/SVG output
summary: Skia compiled to WebAssembly, exposing a Canvas-like API plus Skia-only features: Paragraph text shaping, SkSL runtime shaders, path boolean ops and PDF/SVG surfaces. Runs in Node or the browser; drawing code is a pure function of t, so frames render to PNG without a browser capture loop. Distinguishing strength: richer, more deterministic 2D than Canvas 2D without launching Chromium.
use_when: Over Canvas 2D when you need shaped paragraphs, SkSL shaders or path ops without a browser
Over Playwright capture when 2D frames can render headless in Node as PNG
Need PDF or SVG vector output from the same draw code as raster frames
avoid_when: Simple shapes and text: canvas-2d or canvas-sketch is lighter and well known
3D or GPU-heavy scenes: Three.js or PixiJS over WebGL
DOM or CSS layouts: capture with Playwright instead

assessment.rationale: Maintained (npm 0.42.0 Aug 2026, Skia pushed daily). Runs headless in Node via WASM with no browser, giving Skia text shaping, SkSL runtime shaders and PDF/SVG output that canvas-2d lacks; deterministic per frame.
